description: Defines classes and structures for representing various DNS record data types (RDATA), including SRV, A, AAAA, CNAME, PTR, TXT, and NSEC records, with methods for creation, comparison, and type identification.

classes.name: RecordRdata
classes.description: Abstract base class for DNS record data types, providing interface for type identification and equality comparison.

classes.name: SrvRecordRdata
classes.description: Represents SRV DNS record data, including priority, weight, port, and target domain.

classes.name: ARecordRdata
classes.description: Represents A DNS record data, containing an IPv4 address.

classes.name: AAAARecordRdata
classes.description: Represents AAAA DNS record data, containing an IPv6 address.

classes.name: CnameRecordRdata
classes.description: Represents CNAME DNS record data, containing a canonical name.

classes.name: PtrRecordRdata
classes.description: Represents PTR DNS record data, containing a domain name.

classes.name: TxtRecordRdata
classes.description: Represents TXT DNS record data, containing one or more text strings.

classes.name: NsecRecordRdata
classes.description: Represents NSEC DNS record data, including a bitmap for RR types.

methods.name: HasValidSize
methods.description: Checks if the given data has a valid size for the specified DNS record type.

methods.name: IsEqual
methods.description: Compares two RDATA objects for equality.

methods.name: Type
methods.description: Returns the DNS record type identifier.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates an RDATA object from raw data and a parser.

methods.name: target
methods.description: Returns the target domain name for SRV records.

methods.name: address
methods.description: Returns the IP address for A and AAAA records.

methods.name: cname
methods.description: Returns the canonical name for CNAME records.

methods.name: ptrdomain
methods.description: Returns the domain name for PTR records.

methods.name: texts
methods.description: Returns the list of text strings for TXT records.

methods.name: bitmap_length
methods.description: Returns the length of the bitmap in bits for NSEC records.

methods.name: GetBit
methods.description: Checks if a specific RR type bit is set in the NSEC bitmap.
